summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread got stuck in a wait state (heartbeat age grew, processing stopped at 38), so the queue backed up. Deeper cause of the hang is unknown.
recommended: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed. Add an alert on worker heartbeat age.
